headword: {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}

definitions.gloss: printing company; print shop; printing firm
definitions.explanation: A company that provides printing services — from large commercial printers handling books, magazines, and packaging to smaller shops for business cards, flyers, and promotional materials.

examples.japanese: {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered business cards from a printing company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My father works at a local printing company.

examples.japanese: ⟦デジタル{化|か}→デジタル化：08829_dejitaruka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧、{印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビジネスモデル→ビジネスモデル：29260_bijinesumoderu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{模索|もさく}→模索：13176_mosaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As digitalization progresses, printing companies are searching for new business models.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧ (printing) + {会社|がいしゃ} (company). Japan has a long and significant printing industry, with major companies like {大日本印刷|だいにっぽんいんさつ} (DNP) and {凸版印刷|とっぱんいんさつ} (Toppan) being among the world's largest.

The {会社|がいしゃ} suffix combines with many industry terms to form company names: ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧{会社|がいしゃ} (construction company), ⟦{保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}→保険会社：23530_hokengaisha⟧ (insurance company), ⟦{運送|うんそう}→運送：09791_unsou⟧{会社|がいしゃ} (shipping company).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to commission a printing company
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}: major printing company
- {印刷会社|いんさつがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見積|みつも}もり: printing company estimate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{印刷所|いんさつじょ}→印刷所：23882_insatsujo⟧: print shop — often smaller-scale
- {印刷屋|いんさつや}: printer, print shop — more colloquial
- ⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧: publisher — publishes content, may or may not print
